Run a hook after retry() sleeps

Source: R/retry_after.R
after_sleep.Rd

  • after_sleep_none() does nothing.

  • after_sleep_log() logs a message describing the attempt with logger.

Usage

after_sleep_none()

after_sleep_log(logger = logger_base(), level = "info")

Arguments

logger

A logger, such as logger_message(). Defaults to logger_base(). See extending_log to use a logging package.

level

The level the message is logged at: one of "trace", "debug", "info", "warn", "error" or "fatal". A hook logs a single event, so this is one string, unlike the log_levels() of log_call().

Value

A hook to pass to retry().

Examples

after_sleep_log(logger_message(), level = "info")
#> <fnware::after_sleep_log>
#>  @ logger: <fnware::logger_message>
#>  .. @ trace    : chr "TRACE"
#>  .. @ debug    : chr "DEBUG"
#>  .. @ info     : chr "INFO"
#>  .. @ warn     : chr "WARN"
#>  .. @ error    : chr "ERROR"
#>  .. @ fatal    : chr "FATAL"
#>  .. @ threshold: chr "info"
#>  .. @ logger   : NULL
#>  @ level : chr "info"
